items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: I didn't know Lewis until Chicago... Lurie used to treat me swell, and so I got to know him

ctx.x: Well, maybe some passages I might sound like Lurie's, but I wasn't impersonating them just the way I felt. We all have that same New Orleans jazz spirit in us. But I've never copped after no other trumpet player.
What sort of relations were there between you and Louis? Did you, was he a personal friend of yours in the old days? Or?
